notes.title: Added name change function, Added ranking system, Improved Setting GUI
notes.content:
- Each player can now have a unique name.
- A ranking system has been added to record rankings for all stages. Compete with each other and aim for a higher score.
- Setting GUI has been improved. Provides a more comfortable user experience.

notes.title: Difficulty system reorganization and other convenience improvements
notes.content:
- In order to make it easier for those who are new to the rhythm game genre, we have adjusted the level of difficulty increase more gently and reorganized the Story mode system so that you can select various difficulty levels and play and clear according to your level.
- Guidelines are now displayed to indicate when notes are speeding up and slowing down.
